platform: NVIDIA SM103 (sm_103a, 148 SMs), 4 GPUs, EP4, NVLink
protocol: ABBA palindromic windows inside ONE process (arm vs same-process default_rw0), CUDA Graph replay, 256 MiB L2 flush per replay, slowest rank per window, 15 replays x 5 rounds; "both" mode first runs the randn accuracy gate (bit-exact vs same-process default over every launch + FP32 reference) in the same process. Official DeepGEMM is measured in the same batch.
contamination_rule: Foreign compute processes on the 4 cards are sampled every 2 s; an attempt with any foreign sample is discarded and re-run (max 3). clean=false means all 3 attempts were contaminated: the number is reported but not used for conclusions.

notes.baseline_arm: default_rw0 = V3 defaults: WEAVE_ADAPT_GEMM_CONFIG unset (=1, adaptive host (M,N,K) tuple selector, no device sub-tile chopping), WEAVE_V_HEAD unset (=0, head OFF: only W00..W03 pull, W04..W07 start CLC/TMA/UMMA at once), all-16-warp tail combine on

arm_legend.adapt0: WEAVE_ADAPT_GEMM_CONFIG=0 -> fixed canonical tuple BM=128,BN=128,BK=128,store 32/32,TMEM mode 200,epi_reg_stages=1,max legal stages
arm_legend.gXX / gXXa / g128e2: explicit WEAVE_GEMM1_CONFIG / WEAVE_GEMM2_CONFIG tuples BM[:STORE_BM[:BK[:STAGES[:EPI]]]]; 'a' = asymmetric store_BM_L1=16, store_BM_L2=8
arm_legend.vh1 / vh2: WEAVE_V_HEAD=1/2 non-blocking head helper (W00..W03 + idle epilogue warps W08..W15; W04..W07 never join)
arm_legend.vh1_blk: WEAVE_V_HEAD=1 + internal diagnostic DG_TUNE_HEAD_BLOCKING=1 (V2 all-16-warp blocking head), not a legal 21-knob arm
arm_legend.hbm_k74 / hbm_dD_k74: WEAVE_SCATTER_OWNER=1, WEAVE_SCATTER_STAGING=2 (hbm_dedup), WEAVE_SCATTER_ACTIVE_SMS=74 (K), optionally WEAVE_DISPATCH_ACTIVE_SMS=D (D != K)

ptxas_sm_103a.note: local nvcc -cubin -arch=sm_103a on kernel sources whose template args/macros were edited by hand from a host-emitted source (not each arm's own host-emitted source)
